mentions.name: Embedded vector database library
mentions.description: A small embedded vector database library modeled after SQLite, designed to run as an embedded component with its own file format, which has recently been finalized. The project also serves as a way to learn Rust and low-level programming.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a small embedded vector database lib (à la SQLite). Just finalized the file format, it works pretty great so far.
